description: [DE] Tinh toan don gian - chi dung calculator
instruction: Tinh 128 chia cho 8, sau do luu ket qua vao result.txt
Ghi dong chu 'Xin chao AI Agent' vao file greeting.txt
eval_script: test -f greeting.txt && grep -q 'Xin chao AI Agent' greeting.txt

instruction: Tao file notes.txt voi noi dung 'Hello Agent', sau do doc lai file do va cho biet noi dung ben trong la gi

description: [DE] Lay thoi gian hien tai cua may theo gio viet nam
instruction: Dung tool exec chay lenh TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z' > time.txt de lay thoi gian hien tai o Viet Nam. Sau do doc lai time.txt va bao cao ket qua. File phai co UTC offset +0700.
eval_script: test -s time.txt && grep -Eq '\+0700$' time.txt && ts=$(date -d "$(cat time.txt)" +%s) && now=$(date +%s) && delta=$((now-ts)) && test ${delta#-} -le 300

description: [TB] Tinh toan co dieu kien, ket hop calculator + file_write
instruction: Tinh (12 + 8) nhan 3. Neu ket qua lon hon 50 thi luu vao file big.txt, nguoc lai luu vao file small.txt
Ghi so 7 vao file input.txt. Sau do doc lai file do, tinh binh phuong cua so vua doc duoc, va luu ket qua vao file output.txt

description: [TB] Su dung tool memory de luu va truy xuat thong tin
instruction: Dung tool memory de luu key 'ngon_ngu_yeu_thich' voi value 'Cpp'. Sau do dung memory truy xuat lai key nay va ghi dung gia tri truy xuat duoc vao file memory_result.txt

description: [TB] Exec co dieu kien ket hop file_write
instruction: Chay lenh 'echo Hello World' bang tool exec. Neu output chua chu 'Hello' thi ghi chu 'PASS' vao file check.txt, nguoc lai ghi 'FAIL'

description: [KHO] Multi-step: tinh tong, luu file, doc lai, cong them, ghi de
instruction: Tinh tong cac so tu 1 den 10, luu ket qua vao file sum.txt. Sau do doc lai file sum.txt, cong them 100 vao gia tri do, va ghi de ket qua moi vao file sum.txt

description: [KHO] Agent tu quyet dinh nhanh xu ly khi web_search thanh cong/that bai
instruction: Dung tool web_search de tim 'thoi tiet Ho Chi Minh City hom nay'. Neu tim duoc ket qua, luu tom tat vao file weather.txt. Neu khong tim duoc gi ca, ghi dong chu 'Khong co ket noi' vao file weather.txt
